page_title: SVG Icon Manager for Mac and Windows – Iconset

sources.entry: Iconset - Free, cross-platform and fast SVG icon organizer and manager for Mac and Windows.

summary.name: Iconset
summary.one_liner: Iconset is a fast icon manager for Mac and Windows that organizes SVG icon sets, searches 100,000+ built-in open-source icons offline, and exports to SVG, PNG, React, Vue and Svelte.
use_cases: Organize a large library of SVG icons for a design team
Find and copy open-source icons offline
Convert SVG icons into React, Vue or Svelte components
Export icons as an SVG sprite or PNG at multiple sizes
Share an icon library across a team via a cloud folder
Clean up SVG files by removing scripts, hard-coded colors and missing viewBoxes
summary.what_it_does: Iconset stores icons in sets, folders, tags, collections and favorites, and can import folders of SVGs, IconJar libraries and .set files. It bundles 100,000+ open-source icons from sets such as Lucide, Tabler, Phosphor and Material Symbols that search offline. Its Studio editor lets users recolor, change stroke width, pad, rotate or resize icons before copying them as SVG, JSX, React, Vue, Svelte, data URI or PNG. Export options include typed React components, Vue or Svelte files, SVG sprites, CSS icon classes and PNGs at @1x, @2x and @3x. SVG Doctor scans a library for scripts, hard-coded colors, missing viewBoxes and duplicates, and can fix them.
notable: Built-in 100,000+ open-source icons (MIT, ISC or Apache 2.0) that search offline
Team sharing through Dropbox, iCloud Drive, Google Drive, OneDrive or Box folders with no accounts or servers
SVG Doctor checks and one-click fixes for icon library hygiene
caveats: Free tier is limited to 500 icons and 3 collections; Studio, code formats, PNG and batch export, and the Quick Panel require Pro
Requires macOS 13 Ventura or later or 64-bit Windows 10 or later
Listed as free in awesome-mac, but the page describes a free tier with paid Pro features and one-time pricing
